scripts.package:release: npm run pack:packs && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-release.ps1
scripts.pack:packs: npm run pack:example-effects && npm run pack:readme
scripts.pack:example-effects: npx fvtt package pack --id rave5e --type Module --compendiumName rave5e-example-effects --compendiumType ActiveEffect --inputDirectory packs-src/rave5e-example-effects --outputDirectory packs
scripts.pack:readme: npx fvtt package pack --id rave5e --type Module --compendiumName rave5e-readme --compendiumType JournalEntry --inputDirectory packs-src/rave5e-readme --outputDirectory packs
scripts.unpack:packs: npm run unpack:example-effects && npm run unpack:readme
scripts.unpack:example-effects: npx fvtt package unpack --id rave5e --type Module --compendiumName rave5e-example-effects --compendiumType ActiveEffect --inputDirectory packs --outputDirectory packs-src/rave5e-example-effects --clean
scripts.unpack:readme: npx fvtt package unpack --id rave5e --type Module --compendiumName rave5e-readme --compendiumType JournalEntry --inputDirectory packs --outputDirectory packs-src/rave5e-readme --clean
